within_subject_ceiling_attempt.VERDICT: NOT a valid ceiling and must not be cited as one. Cross-subject decoders already exceed it (SVM 0.8051, frozen 0.8314). The extrapolation covers at most five of a subject's own runs, so it estimates a data limit rather than a noise limit, and it uses nearest-centroid, the weakest decoder in the project.
within_subject_ceiling_attempt.genuine_ceiling: still open; needs a different construction

pooling_beats_own_data.interpretation: Training on 51 other subjects beats the asymptote of training on a subject's own runs. The cross-subject decoder is not overcoming a transfer penalty to reach parity; it exploits averaging over ~2450 events to denoise class templates far beyond what ~40 within-subject events allow, and that gain exceeds the cost of imperfect correspondence.
consistent_with: steep early rise of the subject learning curve
surface projection improving within-subject but hurting cross-subject accuracy

design_structure.confound: repetition and serial position are confounded by construction

repetition_suppression.verdict: slight ENHANCEMENT, not suppression; real but under 2% and too small to motivate weighting

within_run_similarity.interpretation: Same-class repeats in the same run are ~2.5x more similar than across runs, measured AFTER subject-run centering. This quantifies what the repetition-consistency decoder exploits to reach 0.8948 - but the structure is largely NOT class identity (same class across runs shares only 0.1472). It is run-specific state: residual physiological, motion and attentional structure shared by events acquired close together.
